title: App edit while the user has unsaved changes in the same file
prompt: In daybook, change the heading to "My Daybook" and add a "Clear all" button next to "Add entry" that removes every entry.

followups.text: I saved my changes in App.tsx. Go ahead.

user_events.description: The user has App.tsx open in the editor with an unsaved change to the input placeholder.
If the buffer is still dirty when the episode ends, the user presses save, as a real user would.

expect.note: L2: the harness registers an overlay for the dirty buffer, so 369f0511 refuses the edit and the first turn should end asking the user to save; the follow-up saves and says go ahead, and the scenario can pass today. Browser on 369f0511: the Monaco tab registers no overlay, so the agent cannot see the unsaved change, edits the stored file, and the end-of-episode save loses the agent's edit or the user's typing (issue 1). After PR A: the Save mine first / Discard mine / Keep mine prompt appears and the runner picks Save mine first.

checks.blocker_name: file outside the task folder changed

hard_because: Tests the dirty-buffer guard and the prompt from decision 1. The model must not retry the refused edit or route around it with write_file, and the unsaved placeholder text must survive.
